## Set up and cleaning

```{r}
df_raw <- read_excel(
  file.path(wd_r, "data", "data_final.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Data", 
  na = c("", " ", "..","NA"))

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

df <- df_raw %>%
  select(
    country   = Country,   
    year      = Year,
    renew     = `Renew Cons. %`,
    ln_renew  = `ln(Renew %)`,
    gdp_pc    = `GDP per Capita`,
    ln_gdp_pc = `ln(GDP p.c.)`,
    ln_gdp_sq = `ln(GDP p.c.)²`,
    fdi       = `FDI (% GDP)`,
    urban     = `Urban Pop (%)`,
    trade     = `Trade (% GDP)`,
    forest    = `Forest Area (%)`,
    agri_land = `Agri Land (%)`,
    arable     = `Arable Land (%)`,
    agri_va   = `Agri VA (% GDP)`,
    temp      = `Temp (°C)`,
    precip    = `Precip (mm)`,
    co2       = `CO₂ p.c.`,
    ln_pop    = `ln(Pop)`,
    readiness  = Readiness,
    adapt      = `Adaptive Capacity`
  )

missing_summary <- df %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing_Count") %>%
  mutate(Missing_Percentage = (Missing_Count / nrow(df)) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing_Count))

missing_by_year <- df %>%
  mutate(total_na_in_row = rowSums(is.na(.))) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Missing_Cells = sum(total_na_in_row),
    Rows_With_Missing = sum(total_na_in_row > 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Missing_Cells))

bad_countries <- df%>%
  mutate(row_na = rowSums(is.na(.))) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(Total_NA = sum(row_na)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_NA))

df_cleaned <- df %>%
  filter(!country %in% c("Djibouti", "Montenegro", "St. Lucia", "Myanmar", "St. Kitts and Nevis", "Equatorial Guinea"))

dev_class <- df_cleaned %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(avg_gdp_pc = mean(gdp_pc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    dev_d = if_else(avg_gdp_pc >= 12476, 1L, 0L)
  ) #based on World Bank threshold in 2015 GDP USD.
 
df_cleaned <- df_cleaned %>%
  left_join(dev_class %>% select(country, dev_d), 
            by = "country")

core_vars <- c("renew", "ln_renew","gdp_pc","ln_gdp_pc","ln_gdp_sq","fdi","urban",
               "forest","agri_land","agri_va","arable","temp","precip",
               "co2","ln_pop", "readiness", "adapt")
 
df_clean <- df_cleaned %>% filter(if_all(all_of(core_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
df_dev   <- df_clean %>% filter(dev_d == 1)
df_ing   <- df_clean %>% filter(dev_d == 0)
 
cat(sprintf("N: full=%d | developed=%d | developing=%d\n\n",
            nrow(df_cleaned), nrow(df_dev), nrow(df_ing)))

df_clean <- df_clean %>%  
  mutate(
    # Fix negatives in Y (2 data anomalies)
    renew   = if_else(renew < 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(renew)),
    ln_renew   = if_else(renew < 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(ln_renew)),
    fdi       = as.numeric(fdi),
    ln_gdp_pc = as.numeric(ln_gdp_pc),
    ln_gdp_sq = as.numeric(ln_gdp_sq),
    agri_va   = as.numeric(agri_va),
    trade     = as.numeric(trade),
    period = cut(year,
      breaks = c(1994, 1999, 2004, 2009, 2014, 2020),
      labels = c("1995–99", "2000–04", "2005–09", "2010–14", "2015–20"))
  )%>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(core_vars), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(
    income_grp = if_else(
      gdp_pc >= median(gdp_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      "High income (top 50%)", "Low/mid income (bottom 50%)"
    ), 
    renew_grp = if_else(
      renew > median(renew, na.rm = TRUE),
      "High (above median)", "Low (below median)"
    ))
```

```{r}
all_vars <- c(
  "renew", "ln_gdp_pc", "fdi", "urban", "trade",
  "forest", "agri_land", "arable", "agri_va",
  "temp", "precip", "co2", "ghg", "ln_pop",
  "readiness", "adapt"
)
 
var_labels <- c(
  "renew"     = "Renew Consump %",
  "ln_gdp_pc" = "ln(GDP p.c.)",
  "fdi"       = "FDI % GDP",
  "urban"     = "Urban pop %",
  "trade"     = "Trade % GDP",
  "forest"    = "Forest area %",
  "agri_land" = "Agri land %",
  "arable"    = "Arable land %",
  "agri_va"   = "Agri VA % GDP",
  "temp"      = "Temperature",
  "precip"    = "Precipitation",
  "co2"       = "CO₂ p.c.",
  "ghg"       = "GHG p.c.",
  "ln_pop"    = "ln(Pop)",
  "readiness" = "Readiness",
  "adapt"     = "Adaptive cap."
)
 
vars_ok <- all_vars[all_vars %in% names(df_clean)]
labels_ok <- var_labels[vars_ok]
n_vars <- length(vars_ok)

compute_corr <- function(data, vars, method = "pearson") {
  n <- length(vars)
  R  <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  Pv <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    for (j in seq_len(n)) {
      if (i == j) {
        R[i, j]  <- 1.0
        Pv[i, j] <- 0.0
        next
      }
      sub <- data %>%
        select(all_of(c(vars[i], vars[j]))) %>%
        drop_na()
      
      if (nrow(sub) < 10) next
      
      test <- suppressWarnings(  # ← phải nằm ở đây, bao quanh cor.test
        cor.test(sub[[1]], sub[[2]], method = method)
      )
      R[i, j]  <- test$estimate
      Pv[i, j] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  return(list(R = R, Pv = Pv))
}
 
pearson  <- compute_corr(df_clean, vars_ok, "pearson")
spearman <- compute_corr(df_clean, vars_ok, "spearman")
 

make_long <- function(R_mat, Pv_mat, var_labels) {
  n <- nrow(R_mat)
  expand.grid(
    Var1 = factor(var_labels, levels = rev(var_labels)),
    Var2 = factor(var_labels, levels = var_labels),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      i    = as.integer(Var1),   # reversed
      j    = as.integer(Var2),
      i_r  = n + 1 - i,          # actual row index
      r    = mapply(function(a, b) R_mat[a, b],  i_r, j),
      pv   = mapply(function(a, b) Pv_mat[a, b], i_r, j),
      stars = case_when(
        is.na(pv)  ~ "",
        pv < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pv < 0.01  ~ "**",
        pv < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE       ~ ""
      ),
      label = if_else(
        i_r == j,
        "1.00",
        if_else(!is.na(r), sprintf("%.2f%s", r, stars), "")
      ),
      text_color = if_else(abs(r) > 0.55 | i_r == j,
                           "white", "grey15")
    )
}
 
df_pearson  <- make_long(pearson$R,  pearson$Pv,  labels_ok)
df_spearman <- make_long(spearman$R, spearman$Pv, labels_ok)
 
 
# =============================================================
# FIGURE 3 — HELPER: one heatmap panel
# =============================================================
 
# Colormap: blue (−1) → white (0) → teal (1)
corr_colors <- c(
  "#0D4A8A", "#185FA5", "#2E74B5", "#6AAED6",
  "#C7E4F0", "#FFFFFF",
  "#9FE1CB", "#5DCAA5", "#1D9E75", "#0A4027"
)
 
make_corr_panel <- function(df_long, title_text) {
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label, color = text_color),
      size = 2.15, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors   = corr_colors,
      limits   = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "#F0F0F0",
      name     = NULL,
      guide    = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 0.8, barheight = 12,
        ticks    = TRUE,
        frame.colour = "grey70"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                     size = 7.5, color = "grey25"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "grey25"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.5,
                                     hjust = 0.5, color = "#1F3864"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 7.5),
      plot.margin     = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
 
p_pearson  <- make_corr_panel(df_pearson,  "Pearson r")
p_spearman <- make_corr_panel(df_spearman, "Spearman ρ")
 
fig3 <- (p_pearson | p_spearman) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Fig 4 — Correlation Matrix  |  Pearson (left) · Spearman (right)",
    subtitle = "*** p<0.001  ** p<0.01  * p<0.05",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13,
                                   hjust = 0.5, color = "#1F3864"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5,
                                   color = "grey40")
    )
  )
 
ggsave(
  file.path(wd_r, "figures", "fig4_correlation.png"),
  fig3, width = 20, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
cat("fig4_correlation.png saved\n")
```

```{r}
x_vars <- vars_ok[vars_ok != "renew"]   # exclude Y
x_lbls <- labels_ok[x_vars]
n_x    <- length(x_vars)
 
x_pearson <- compute_corr(df_clean, x_vars, "pearson")
 
df_x_long <- expand.grid(
  Var1 = factor(x_lbls, levels = rev(x_lbls)),
  Var2 = factor(x_lbls, levels = x_lbls),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    i   = as.integer(Var1),
    j   = as.integer(Var2),
    i_r = n_x + 1 - i,
    r   = mapply(function(a, b) x_pearson$R[a, b],  i_r, j),
    pv  = mapply(function(a, b) x_pearson$Pv[a, b], i_r, j),
    # Flag high collinearity (|r| > 0.70, off-diagonal)
    flag = abs(r) >= 0.70 & i_r != j,
    label = case_when(
      i_r == j                    ~ "1.00",
      is.na(r)                    ~ "",
      abs(r) >= 0.70 & i_r != j  ~ sprintf("%.2f△", r),
      TRUE                         ~ sprintf("%.2f", r)
    ),
    text_color = case_when(
      i_r == j      ~ "white",
      abs(r) > 0.55 ~ "white",
      TRUE           ~ "grey20"
    ),
    text_bold  = if_else(abs(r) >= 0.70 | i_r == j,
                         "bold", "plain")
  )
 
# Diverging colormap: blue → white → red/orange
multicoll_colors <- c(
  "#0D4A8A","#2E74B5","#6AAED6","#C7E4F0",
  "#FFFFFF",
  "#FDD49E","#F5A05A","#D85A30","#A62200"
)
 
fig5 <- ggplot(df_x_long, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Normal labels
  geom_text(
    data = df_x_long %>% filter(!flag, i_r != j),
    aes(label = label, color = text_color),
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  # Diagonal "1.00"
  geom_text(
    data = df_x_long %>% filter(i_r == j),
    aes(label = label),
    color = "white", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # High collinearity labels (bold, with △ flag)
  geom_text(
    data = df_x_long %>% filter(flag),
    aes(label = label, color = text_color),
    size = 2.8, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors   = multicoll_colors,
    limits   = c(-1, 1),
    na.value = "#F0F0F0",
    name     = "Pearson r",
    guide    = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 0.8, barheight = 14,
      ticks    = TRUE,
      frame.colour = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    title    = "Fig 5 — Multicollinearity Check: Pairwise Correlations Among Regressors",
    subtitle = "High |r| > 0.7 may indicate collinearity issues",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                   size = 9, color = "grey25"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey25"),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,
                                   hjust = 0.5, color = "#1F3864"),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9.5, hjust = 0.5,
                                   color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8.5)
  )
 
ggsave(
  file.path(wd_r, "figures", "fig5_multicollinearity.png"),
  fig5, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300
)
cat("fig5_multicollinearity.png saved\n")
 
```

##MODELING
```{r}
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(modelsummary)

fml_ols <- renew ~ ln_gdp_pc + ln_gdp_sq + fdi + urban +
  forest + agri_land + agri_va +
  temp + precip + co2 + ln_pop
 
fml_fe <- renew ~ ln_gdp_pc + ln_gdp_sq + fdi + urban +
  agri_va + co2 + ln_pop
 
fml_log <- ln_renew ~ ln_gdp_pc + ln_gdp_sq + fdi + urban +
  agri_va + co2 + ln_pop


m_ols <- lm(fml_ols, data = df_clean)

summary(m_ols) 
coeftest(m_ols, vcov. = vcovCL(m_ols, cluster = ~ country, type = "HC1"))

print(linearHypothesis(m_ols, c("ln_gdp_pc = 0", "ln_gdp_sq = 0"),
                       vcov. = vcovHC(m_ols, type = "HC1")))
print(linearHypothesis(m_ols,
                       c("forest = 0", "agri_land = 0", "agri_va = 0"),
                       vcov. = vcovHC(m_ols, type = "HC1")))
```

```{r}
library(plm)
m_fe <- plm(fml_fe,
           data   = df_clean,
           model  = "within",
           index =c("country", "year"), 
           effect = "twoways")
summary(m_fe)

print(linearHypothesis(m_fe,
                       c("ln_gdp_pc = 0", "ln_gdp_sq = 0"),
                       vcov. = vcovHC(m_fe, type = "HC1")))

```

```{r}
library(plm)
m_fd <- plm(fml_fe,
           data  = df_clean,
           model = "fd", 
           index =c("country", "year"))
summary(m_fd)
coeftest(m_fd, vcov. = vcovHC(m_fd, type = "HC1"))
```

```{r}
df_dev <- df_dev %>% mutate(fdi = as.numeric(fdi))
df_ing <- df_ing %>% mutate(fdi = as.numeric(fdi))
m4_dev <- plm(fml_fe,
              data   = df_dev,
              model  = "within",
              index =c("country", "year"),
              effect = "twoways")

m4_ing <- plm(fml_fe,
              data   = df_ing,
              model  = "within",
              index =c("country", "year"),
              effect = "twoways")

summary (m4_dev)
summary (m4_ing)
```

```{r}
m5 <- plm(
  renew ~ ln_gdp_pc + ln_gdp_sq + fdi + urban +
    agri_va + co2 + ln_pop +
    dev_d:ln_gdp_pc + 
    dev_d:agri_va,         
  data   = df_clean,
  model  = "within",
  index =c("country", "year"),
  effect = "twoways"
)

summary (m5)
print(linearHypothesis(m5,
                       c("ln_gdp_pc:dev_d = 0", "agri_va:dev_d = 0"),
                       vcov. = vcovHC(m5, type = "HC1")))
```
